Creator Day returns this Friday November 28th! From 8am to 8am UTC (midnight to midnight Pacific) on Friday, we’re waiving itch.io’s platform fee on all transactions across the site. That means creators will get the most revenue possible per transaction.

The start of creator day coincides with our Black Friday 2025 site-wide sale. We already have 15,000 projects signed up to go on sale, we hope you’re looking forward to it!

  • If you’re a developer head to your dashboard for instructions on how to participate if you haven’t added your project already
  • If you’re looking to pick up some new games, assets, tabletop games, or more then come back this Friday to see what’s available

Note that Creator Day only lasts for 24 hours but we’ll have site-wide promotions through the weekend through December 3rd.

Thank you for supporting creators!
